14724|92b80d28.name: Bubulo Acerbus
14724|92b80d28.text:
The exiles of Gnomeregan find ourselves in even more dire straits by running low on cloth reserves!  Perhaps you can help us, eh?!

Bring me extra cloth pieces you might have to help us replenish our stocks.  By donating them, you'll be earning the respect and trust of gnomes everywhere.  That's something that money can't buy!  Well, I guess cloth does, but that's beside the point...

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2086|4eb20e0f.name: Valstag Ironjaw
2086|4eb20e0f.text: It takes strong arms and brave hearts to keep the town of Menethil safe!

258785|726390d0.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|726390d0.text: Surrender to the Light, $N. How can I help you serve today?

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

2039-accept.name: Gnoarn
2039-accept.text:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, $N.
2039-accept.title: Find Bingles

2159-accept.name: Porthannius
2159-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c.  Can you offer me aid?  I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar.  But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.

Can you deliver this package for me?  It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn.  It lies along the road, to the south.
2159-accept.title: Dolanaar Delivery

279-accept.name: Karl Boran
279-accept.text:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
279-accept.title: Claws from the Deep

2922-accept.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
2922-accept.text:
When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot.  It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized.  Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed.  It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!

But perhaps it can be salvaged.  Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
2922-accept.title: Save Techbot's Brain!

2927-accept.name: Gnoarn
2927-accept.text:
You don't think I was always bald, do you? No sir! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.

<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>

Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!

Perhaps it's not too late, $N. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
2927-accept.title: The Day After

301-complete.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-complete.text:
Curse that Ironband!  I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.

So...where did the blastpowder go?!?
301-complete.title: Report to Ironforge

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

302-accept.name: Prospector Stormpike
302-accept.text:
If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it!  I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.  He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.

And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination.  The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
302-accept.title: Powder to Ironband

3117-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3117-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our $c trainer, Ayanna. It seems Ayanna would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
3117-accept.title: Etched Sigil

3117-complete.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-complete.text:
As you experience what Shadowglen has to teach you, come see me--I will be able to help you understand more about your role as a $c and what you are capable of.

These are dangerous times, $N, do not take for granted the skill of your pets--there are things in this world more dangerous than you can imagine. Go with Elune and return to me again.
3117-complete.title: Etched Sigil

3117-progress.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-progress.text:
You've arrived, and none too soon, $N. Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a $c; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
3117-progress.title: Etched Sigil

3519-accept.name: Iverron
3519-accept.text:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
3519-accept.title: A Friend in Need

3519-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3519-complete.text: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
3519-complete.title: A Friend in Need

3521-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-accept.text:
We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
3521-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-complete.text:
Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
3521-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3522-accept.text:
The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, $N.
3522-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-complete.name: Iverron
3522-complete.text:
What is this, $N?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote.>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
3522-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

4161-accept.name: Zarrin
4161-accept.text:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a $c, $N, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, $N.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
4161-accept.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-complete.name: Zarrin
4161-complete.text: Always remember what I have shown you today, $N. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
4161-complete.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4495-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
4495-accept.text:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
4495-accept.title: A Good Friend

4495-complete.name: Iverron
4495-complete.text: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?
4495-complete.title: A Good Friend

455-complete.name: Valstag Ironjaw
455-complete.text:
Your report is full of bad news!

I see the Dragonmaws are making a strong move into Algaz.  Normally the Dragonmaws just hide up in the hills.  What made them surge into Algaz is still a mystery...

Thank you, $N.  And we'll probably want your help dealing with these orcs.
455-complete.title: The Algaz Gauntlet

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-complete.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-complete.text: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N.  A young $c like yourself has a promising future.
457-complete.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

463-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
463-accept.text:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
463-accept.title: The Greenwarden

469-accept.name: Einar Stonegrip
469-accept.text:
Greetings, traveler!

Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
469-accept.title: Daily Delivery

469-complete.name: James Halloran
469-complete.text:
Hmm, this is from Einar, right? Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. No doubt it's some differences with the wife!

Maybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...
469-complete.title: Daily Delivery

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

470-accept.name: Sida
470-accept.text:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
470-accept.title: Digging Through the Ooze

471-accept.name: James Halloran
471-accept.text:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
471-accept.title: Apprentice's Duties

484-accept.name: James Halloran
484-accept.text:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
484-accept.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-complete.name: James Halloran
484-complete.text: Nice work you've done here, $N. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
484-complete.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

488-accept.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-accept.text:
Eager for work, I see.  Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling $c to perform my bidding.

You see, $N, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having.  But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents.  Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

Let's keep this our little secret, $r.
488-accept.title: Zenn's Bidding

7807-progress.name: Bubulo Acerbus
7807-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Gnomeregan Exiles for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7807-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

916-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-accept.text:
I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave.  They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

First, I would like some of their venom.  Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north.  I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
916-accept.title: Webwood Venom

916-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders.  It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
916-complete.title: Webwood Venom

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-accept.text:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young $c.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
917-accept.title: Webwood Egg

917-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-complete.text: Ah, very good.  I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here.  I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, $N.  You have been a great help to me.
917-complete.title: Webwood Egg

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

920-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
920-accept.text:
$N, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
920-accept.title: Tenaron's Summons

920-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
920-complete.text: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
920-complete.title: Tenaron's Summons

921-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-accept.text:
It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, $N. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
921-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

921-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-complete.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
921-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

928-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
928-accept.text:
While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, $N. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
928-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

94818-complete.name: High Priestess Mims
94818-complete.text:
Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great $c, $N. Maintain your vigilance and dedication!

You are ready for your next lesson in service.
94818-complete.title: Contingency Plan

96606-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96606-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96606-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96606-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96606-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96630-accept.name: Unknown
96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

96630-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96630-complete.title: The Adventurer

96630-progress.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96630-progress.title: The Adventurer

96634-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96634-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96634-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97236-accept.name: Unknown
97236-accept.text: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236-accept.title: Fang of Githyiss

97236-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
97236-complete.text:
My, my. How I do love surprises, $N.

This specimen will surely help further my studies.
97236-complete.title: Fang of Githyiss

97949-accept.name: Lyreena Duskblade
97949-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97977-accept.name: Tarindrella
97977-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977-accept.title: Nature's Call

97977-complete.name: Tarindrella
97977-complete.text:
Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...

Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
97977-complete.title: Nature's Call

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98197-complete.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-complete.text:
Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix.

Thank you, $c. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197-complete.title: Spoils of War

98197-progress.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-progress.text: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!
98197-progress.title: Spoils of War

98282-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282-accept.title: Alchemical Hazards

997-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
997-accept.text:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
997-accept.title: Denalan's Earth
